name: progression
description: XP, levels, skill trees, and achievements. Ported from os.realm.watch/servers/progression. Owns the players, xp_events, skill_trees, player_skills, achievements, player_achievements tables in the game sidecar DB (~/.realmwatch/game.db).

cli.summary: Track XP, levels, skill trees, and achievements

verbs.name: player
verbs.summary: Show current level, XP, class, and unlocked skills

verbs.name: skills
verbs.summary: List the skill tree and which skills are unlocked

verbs.name: grant-xp
verbs.summary: Grant XP to the player (args: amount, source)

verbs.name: unlock-skill
verbs.summary: Unlock a skill by id (args: skill)

verbs.name: grant-achievement
verbs.summary: Grant an achievement by id (args: achievement)
